reason: £19.99 plus £4.99 delivery for gummies I've never tried is too much when the energy bills are up. Sweets for children don't feel like a serious supplement to me, and I'd rather spend on tablets I already know.
objection: Gummies full of sugar and glucose syrup, and no reviews yet, so I've no idea whether 180mg of magnesium from a new brand does anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: Tablets in the same strength, or free delivery on one jar plus proof from women my age that they work.
